# MOUTHBREATHER

> Boston, Massachusetts experimental hardcore / mathcore / grindcore band, formed December 2016. Self-described "Massachusetts Gadget Metal" — fuses metallic hardcore, mathcore, post-hardcore, and grindcore. The five-track EP "If I Lose Everything, You All Lose Everything" was released independently on August 7, 2026.

## Members

- Brett Cates — vocals
- Ryan Fosdick — guitar
- Derek Lamoreaux — bass
- Nick Cates — drums

## Current Release

- **If I Lose Everything, You All Lose Everything** (EP, August 7, 2026, MouthBreather) — five tracks, 10 minutes 10 seconds. [Bandcamp](https://mouthbreathercult.bandcamp.com/album/if-i-lose-everything-you-all-lose-everything) · [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/album/6bitDe06o4zXQv2byD5OeU) · [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/album/if-i-lose-everything-you-all-lose-everything-ep/6794378936)
- Track list: "Terrified" (2:37), "Gold Star For You" (1:57), "Repeat After Me" (2:09), "You Look Down On Me" (2:03), "Annie" (1:25).
- [Terrified — Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/3XLHS1TxlTSVNheA7u7WL4): release-day focus track, selected for Spotify's **All New Metal** editorial playlist.
- [Terrified — Official Music Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lZbxzEKQUIo): official video released August 7, 2026.

## Discography

- **If I Lose Everything, You All Lose Everything** (EP, August 2026, independent)
- **Self-Tape** (LP, November 2023, Good Fight Music) — concept album where every track is influenced by a different movie. Engineered as a single coherent statement on metallic hardcore. [Listen on Bandcamp](https://mouthbreathercult.bandcamp.com/album/self-tape) · [Vinyl on Deathwish](https://deathwishinc.com/products/mouthbreather-self-tape)
- **I'm Sorry Mr. Salesman** (EP, 2021) — heavy amalgamation of hardcore, mathcore, and grindcore.
- **Dollmeat** (EP, 2018) — features the music video for "Feeding Time."
- **Pig** (EP, 2017) — debut EP.

## Press & Context

- Genre: experimental hardcore, mathcore, metalcore, grindcore, post-hardcore. Self-coined: "Gadget Metal."
- Influences cited by the band include Deftones, Primus, Tool, Underoath, Converge, Curl Up and Die.
- Hometown: Boston, Massachusetts, USA.
- Active since: December 2016.
- Label context: Self-Tape was released by Good Fight Music and distributed via Deathwish Inc.; the 2026 EP is credited to MouthBreather.
